name: End Times
overview: Scripture reveals that the end times will be marked by increased knowledge and global movement, as Daniel was instructed to seal the book until that period (Daniel 12:4). Jesus taught that the gospel must be preached worldwide before the end comes, followed by unprecedented tribulation (Matthew 24:14, 21). While signs will precede His return, the exact day and hour remain known only to the Father, urging believers to remain watchful and prepared at all times (Matthew 24:36, 42).
